speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To begin your assessment, could you please describe the specific onset and duration of the seizures your baby has been experiencing?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoglycemic seizure secondary to prematurity and intrauterine infection (chorioamnionitis).

REQUEST TEST: Blood glucose, blood gas analysis, and serum calcium.
REQUEST IMAGES: Head ultrasound.
